name: account_detail
description: Log in, open Accounts Overview, click into account {{account_id}} to open its detail page, and read the account type into an output named account_type and the balance into an output named balance

approved_plan.goal: Log in, open Accounts Overview, click into account {{account_id}} to open its detail page, and read the account type into an output named account_type and the balance into an output named balance

steps.intent: Log in with the supplied credentials and reach the Accounts Overview page
steps.action: Replay reusable fragment parabank_login@1.0.0 using the supplied username and password

steps.intent: Click on the link for account {{account_id}} to open its detail page
steps.action: On the Accounts Overview page, locate and click the link whose text or href corresponds to account_id, navigating to the account detail page

steps.intent: Read the account type and balance from the account detail page into outputs
steps.action: Extract the account type label (e.g. CHECKING, SAVINGS) into account_type and the current balance value into balance from the account detail page

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: The username used to log in to ParaBank

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: The password used to log in to ParaBank

parameters.name: account_id
parameters.description: The account ID to click into on the Accounts Overview page

approved_plan.success_signal: The account detail page is displayed, showing a heading or section that identifies the account (e.g. "Account Details") along with visible fields for account type and balance

inputs.name: username
inputs.description: The username used to log in to ParaBank

inputs.name: account_id
inputs.description: The account ID to click into on the Accounts Overview page

inputs.name: password
inputs.description: The password used to log in to ParaBank

outputs.name: account_type
outputs.description: Read from the page during discovery; returned as text

outputs.name: balance
outputs.description: Read from the page during discovery; a currency amount, returned as a number

business_outcomes.description: The requested account_id does not appear in the Accounts Overview table; the account does not exist or does not belong to the authenticated user.
The login subflow was rejected because the supplied username/password combination is invalid or the account is locked.
The authenticated user has no accounts listed in the Accounts Overview, so there is nothing to navigate into.

when.value: The username and password could not be verified.

then.message: Login rejected: the supplied credentials were not accepted by ParaBank. Verify username and password and retry.
Accounts Overview loaded but contains no accounts for this user. Cannot navigate to account_id.

candidates.rationale: accessible role and name, most stable across restyling

then.message: The link for account_id {{account_id}} was not found in the Accounts Overview table. The account may not exist or may not belong to this user.

when.value: An internal error has occurred and has been logged.

then.message: ParaBank returned an internal error when navigating to the account detail page. This is an application-side fault; surface to operations for investigation.

on_exhausted.message: No row or link matching account_id {{account_id}} was found in the Accounts Overview table. The account does not exist or is not accessible to this user.
